title: Extraction and finishing a run
summary: A run ends when your crew reaches an extraction point with loot: R.E.P.O. tracks the extraction points on a level and records how many extractions you have completed.
body: Extraction is a place on the level, not a button. You have to find it and physically bring your loot to it.
The game tracks the extraction points while you play, which is why the interface can point you towards one.
Completing an extraction is recorded, so progress carries between runs.
What this entry does not tell you: quota amounts, payout maths or deadlines. We have not verified those numbers, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: Extraction happens at tracked points on the level.
The game records how many extractions have been completed.
